_comment: Board-texture fixture parsed by both test suites (plan H.3, the ADR-028/031 discipline): tests/integration/test_board_texture_fixture.py runs every board through the dbt macros in macros/board.sql (the SQL the marts are built from), and web/packages/poker-core/test/texture.test.ts runs them through textureTags() in src/texture.ts. `tags` is what textureTags(board) returns: the registry values of `dimensions`, in that order, one per dimension the board has reached ('' rows of the SQL side are dropped). Cards are spelled as ReplayHand.board carries them. Ranks count 2..A; the ace also plays low. `connected` = three board ranks inside one five-card window; `oesd` = two board ranks inside a four-card window open at both ends (2345 through TJQK; A234 and JQKA are one-ended). A later street's card takes the FIRST class in `precedence` that applies: a flush card (at least two of its suit already on the board, so the third, fourth or fifth of a suit), a straight card (it takes part in a straight that needs fewer hole cards than before: the board's best five-card window reaches three ranks, or rises to four or five), pairing an earlier rank, a second card of its suit (turn only), above every earlier card, else blank. A card that brings straight draws but no straight is a blank by these rules — ADR-082 records why; ADR-083 is the fixture discipline itself.

an overcard that makes QKA fit a five-window: straight precedes overcard
